reviews.author: Dan Schwarzlose
reviews.text: I had several trees and bushes that needed trimming, as well as an area of yard that needed to be excavated to grow new things. I called Marvin and he came out that very day to discuss the work and give me a quote, which was very reasonable. He also took the time to tell me what I shouldn't worry about and waste money on, which I really appreciate. Marvin and his team started the next day and finished the following afternoon. They were extremely efficient and proficient, friendly and focused, and had all the needed equipment and know-how to execute the job. We enthusiastically recommend Marvin and Freeman Tree Care for anyone's needs with trees, bushes, excavation, and more!

reviews.author: Janice Fisher
reviews.text: I highly recommend Freemans. Marvin came out gave me a quote and within 2 days the work had been completed. Did a great job with cleaning up as well. Very honest and reliable and reasonable. They went above and beyond. I will be calling on them in the future with any work that I need done. Thanks Marvin for Great Work! Before and after pictures.

reviews.author: Ron Clark
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew did an outstanding job today trimming our trees and all our schrubery ... very effecient very professional .. i would definitely recommend them for any tree projects you might have!

reviews.author: Bilbo Baggins
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew were great from the beginning. They were punctual, friendly, and polite. They got to work as soon as they got here and it was incredible to watch. Watching his main tree climber was like watching a trapeze artist. They cleaned up so nicely, even more than I had asked them to. Even put back the grandkids trampoline. I highly recommend them, they were good folks that do good work and a very reasonable price. Thank you guys.

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: I needed to have a couple of good sized trees trimmed, so I called Freeman Tree Care after reading many positive reviews on Google. Marvin the owner came by the next day and gave a very reasonable estimate, he's quite personable, knowledgeable, and easy to chat with. Marvin got me on the schedule quickly, they showed up on time for the appointment and his guys did a fantastic job. I absolutely recommend Marvin and his company for tree service.

reviews.author: Scott Wallace (Se7enwallace)
reviews.text: These folks did an amazing job at my Fathers place in the Waynesville area. Excellent service and quality work at an affordable price. They worked hard and quickly to remove around 30 stumps from the front yard and left the property looking wonderful with great clean up. The also gave an excellent price on cutting and stacking around 20 more trees at a later date. These folks come highly recommend for quality work and reasonable pricing.

reviews.author: Michael Fasciani
reviews.text: Marvin and team took out a huge problematic, hollowed out maple tree with precision. They arrived on time, worked diligently throughout the day and left my property in great shape. We are grateful for the effort and the outcome!

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.text: Marvin and his team did an excellent job! He provided a same-day quote for a tree we initially planned to trim, but Marvin noticed a cavity halfway up the trunk that posed a risk by allowing water to enter and rot the tree. The team returned the same week, just before Hurricane Helene, to safely remove the tree beside our house and some wood rounds from a previous cut. Sure enough, the center was rotted and full of water. They handled everything professionally and communication was great throughout. We wouldn’t hesitate to contact them again!

reviews.author: Janine Propst
reviews.text: Marvin was very responsive, came to provide an estimate the next day and quickly completed the work clearing some nuisance trees like locust and Princess Trees. Replies quickly to inquires. Very nice and knowledgeable person. We recommend Freeman Tree Care.

reviews.author: Elliott Adler
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew removed two trees right next to our house. They performed this with precision trimming and cutting. All branches and tree sections were taken down under complete control. I recommend Marvin and his company to anyone needing tree care service. They were available in short order, arrived as scheduled and completed the job as promised.

reviews.author: Alexander (WhatARiot)
reviews.text: Very professional and took a lot of great care to bring down a massive tree that was right next to our house that was dead. And we’re very mindful of trying to preserve healthy vegetation around the area. Really happy with the service and their price was fair. This is really hard and dangerous work and I appreciate them coming out and doing such a good job.

reviews.author: J Robinson
reviews.text: Feeman Tree Care helped take down three large trees on my property that had become a problem and a potential hazard. They were professional and fast. Marvin the owner was extremely knowledgeable and the crew highly skilled. I would definitely call on them again and would strongly recommend them.

reviews.author: Benjamin Pryor
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew do excellent work at a fair price. He is honest about necessary procedures and communicates well throughout the job: a top-notch tree man.

reviews.author: Sam Bowman
reviews.text: We were helping an elderly woman with her house and yard and needed a giant pile of branches and bags of leaves removed. They came out gave a great quote and had it gone the next morning, fantastic customer service,quick,and professional. I would recommend Freeman tree service to anyone who asks and even those who don't! Thanks again

reviews.author: Michael Willis
reviews.text: I noticed a tree on my property that was close to falling. Possibly on power lines. So I called Freeman’s who was recommended by two neighbors. As luck would have it, they were working in the same area. Marvin came to check it out within the hour. Seeing the danger, his crew showed up the same day. Marvin is very personable and knowledgeable. The crew worked hard and efficient. Got tree down, cut it up for me for firewood. They cleaned the area when finished. It made the difficult situation easy. Thanks to Freeman

reviews.author: Ivey Ierna
reviews.text: We needed to have several trees removed an also wanted to have 6 trees trimmed back. Freeman Tree Care did a fantastic job. Marvin was very responsive and was able to work me into his schedule quickly. The pricing was very competitive and they went over and above what I would expect. They were very careful and minimized damage to other trees and bushes and were very thorough cleaning everything up afterward. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Craig Gibson
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew are true professionals in tree removal. Excellent service, timely and very affordable for the work they did. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Holly W
reviews.text: Marvin and his team did a fantastic job! We had a big maple tree in our front yard that was rotting quickly. It was so close to our house, but his team cut it down safely and efficiently. They cleaned up so good that our yard looked better than when they first got here. It was a great price for wonderful service.

reviews.author: Jo Dee
reviews.text: Marvin cleared out a ton of brush, along with a dead tree removal for half the price of our previous tree trimmer service who removed one tree. I really wish I took more 'before' pictures. The amount of work he did, in the short amount of time.. Impossible to believe could be done. Very glad our neighbors referred him.

reviews.author: Vickie C
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew cut down a tall tree for me. It was amazing to watch. Professional, attention to safety, courteous, cleaned up area after completed. Very happy with his work.

reviews.author: Charles Turner
reviews.text: Great company, easy to work with and they do what they say they will do. After the job was completed their cleanup made the area look better than before. We would hire them again and highly recommend any one needing tree work to call them

reviews.author: Gary Gebski
reviews.text: I called Freeman Tree Care on a Saturday and Marvin came out the same day to review and provide an estimate. His team arrived the following week and knocked the job out in a professional and timely manner. I would recommend his company to anyone and I will use his services again for my tree removal or tree trimming needs.

reviews.author: Christine Turner
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew are meticulous, skilled and precise. They handled everything professionally and communication was great throughout. 5 trees taken out and several trimmed. Fair priced and left everything clean and neat, above and beyond. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jerry Mann
reviews.text: We had a tree fall on our house. I called a few companies for removal and they were all 2-3 weeks out. Marvin was recommended by one of the other companies and said he would give my number to Marvin. I didn’t have a chance to call Marvin since he called me first. He said the job sounds like an emergency and he and his crew will be there in the morning. Just like he said he and his crew showed up early at the specified time. They were all very professional and specific about how to remove the tree without any damage to the house and the property. We were impressed with the safety procedures and how they rigged their gear as they climbed the tree to cut and lowered the limbs and branches. They were very respectful of our property and they cleaned all the debris before they left. Since then we used them on a few other projects and one of our neighbors used them as well and said they did an excellent job. Freeman’s tree service prices are fair. Marvin does what he says he’s going to do and no surprises. This is so hard to find these days. We highly recommend Freeman’s tree service. Jerry Mann

reviews.author: Darrell Burris
reviews.text: My first time using a tree service. I called Marvin for a quote and he was there within the hour and was there the very next day to do the work. Marvin and his crew know what they are doing, very professional and friendly and also reasonably priced. I will definitely use them again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tracy Gimbel
reviews.text: We were extremely happy with the work and customer service provided by Freeman Tree Care! We were noticing an issue with our Balsam Firs and Marvin came out the same day, shared a detailed diagnosis, provided a quote, and started the next day. We were so worried we were going to loose all of our firs and thanks to Freeman Tree Care that’s not going to happen. We will definitely use Freeman Tree Care for all our future needs.

reviews.author: Thomas Brooker
reviews.text: Marvin did a grate job removing a large maple. The tree was in a difficult location between three homes and power lines. He removed the entire tree with minimal damage to surrounding scrubs and plants, and no damage to structures (it was a tight area). He was professional in all ways. Fair price and good communication I’m gonna have him back for some more work. Thanks Marvin

reviews.author: Paul Sullivan
reviews.text: It was a pleasure working with Freeman Tree Care. They gave me a quote and kept that price. Work was done on time and professionally. Communication was excellent.

reviews.author: Jessie Harrell
reviews.text: Even though Marvin was slightly more than the other quote we received, we felt very comfortable with how knowledgeable he was. His crew took down two large trees very near a power line, and we knew we wanted someone who really knew what they were doing for that job. He also advised that beetles were the reason the trees had died, and if we left the trunks on the property (as we did with another tree that didn’t have beetles), we risked the beetles moving to other trees. The other company did not advise of this and it could have led to more tree loss. Marvin’s crew also topped a number of trees for us and opened up our Mountain View tremendously. Marvin was friendly, punctual, and had great communication.

reviews.author: Peter Strell
reviews.text: Very professional team. Showed up on time to provide quote, and also to start work. Had several trees removed, two very large. Well planned work to prevent damage to home, plants, landscape. Work complete and debris all cleaned up in just a little over a day. For a job done right, call Freeman!

reviews.author: Jakub Kurzak
reviews.text: It was a real pleasure working with Marvin. We were in a tough spot after our previous contractor left the job unfinished, but Marvin stepped in and saved the day. He handled some seriously tricky tree work, big trees just a few feet from our cabin, and one large one hanging directly over the roof. On top of that, he cleared out a massive amount of wood, both from what the last guy left behind and the trees he took down himself. The job was done quickly, the price was fair, and honestly, the communication was outstanding. We couldn’t be there in person most of the time, but Marvin kept us updated with pictures every step of the way. He’ll definitely be our first call for any future projects. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Willis
reviews.text: I am extremely pleased with the job Marvin and his men did taking down some dangerous trees overhanging our house. He was prompt, efficient, and when the job was done, everything was thoroughly cleaned up. They also helped take out some additional trees I had been wanting to eliminate. I was particularly impressed with the professional work shown by the men and their attention to using good safety procedures. As to cost, Freeman Tree Care was very reasonable. Everything was spelled out in detail . and done according to plan. I will have no problem recommending Freeman Tree Services to anyone needing the work.

reviews.author: Tom R.
reviews.text: Marvin was on time for both the estimate and the tree trimming work. He’s friendly and professional. His price was lower than I expected. Marvin and his staff did a great job trimming a large black walnut tree and cleaning up the mess. I would certainly use Freeman Tree Care again.

reviews.author: Randall Snelson
reviews.text: I had a large tree that had blown down into another tree barely holding it. It was a danger to anyone coming up my driveway. Marvin immediately replied to my message and had the tree safely down and cut into firewood sized logs within hours at a fair price. Very knowledgeable, consultative, and trustworthy. Hard to find people like him today.

reviews.author: Robert Beal
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve used Marvin and his team. Once just to remove a couple trees and top 4 or 5 more. His team was careful and did the job to my satisfaction and the price was right. The second job was much more involved. A rather large tree needed to be removed and a large scale job of excavation was involved around a delicate well house structure. They completed the job perfectly with care and on time. Marvin is a follow thru guy and interested in satisfying his customer. I highly recommend Freeman Tree Care.

reviews.author: Lawrence Katz
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew arrived on time and ready to work. They were well-prepared with all the necessary equipment and safety gear. Watching them maneuver and selectively trim the large trees was impressive; their precision and care ensured no damage to my property. They even handled a tricky tree branch close to my house with exceptional skill. Marvin and his family have deep roots, no pun intended, in the community. I also like the way he treats his crew.

reviews.author: Joyce Phillips
reviews.text: Marvin gave us a very reasonable quote and was able to take the trees down on the same day. Very thankful for his quick response. He's a super nice guy who knows what he's doing. Will definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Lee Small
reviews.text: We had 100' poplar tree that was close to our home that needed to come down. Marvin and his crew did a great job on the work and the pricing was reasonable. I would definitely hire his team again.

reviews.author: Diane Ayres
reviews.text: Freeman tree care did an excellent job removing 2 large trees in a tight space, they cleaned up the area with care. We are thrilled to deal with a company who communicates well & are prompt & through. Thank you for your great service at a very fair price

reviews.author: Dillsboro Local
reviews.text: Marvin is awesome. He's someone that obviously cares about trees and the quality of his work. He's prompt, honest and professional. The work he performed on my property was outstanding and I was very impressed throughout the whole process. Definitely planning on reaching back out for more work when needed. Thanks Marvin and crew!

reviews.author: Ann Lumaghi
reviews.text: Freeman Tree Care is great! They took out one tree, 3 shrubs and did such a wonderful job, I asked them to come back and do the pruning of 7 shrubs. They are precise, matching heights of bushes by front walkway. Cleaned up the beds, took trash away. They were very honest about some of my shrubs, when I asked if this one should just be removed. Appreciated his opinion.Will be using them again this fall.

reviews.author: Jeff Mogle
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew did an excellent job! I was first impressed with his promptness as he showed up to give us an estimate and arrived at the time he said he would. Something not common in today’s world but much appreciated when it happens. He then surpassed our expectations with the job he and his team did for us. Easy to contact, easy to work with, and does a fantastic job. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: W Urban
reviews.text: We had a couple of tree stumps that needed grinding and 2 old fallen trees across our creek that we wanted removed. He took care of these concerns and also addressed a dead tree that should come down as it could cause damage being close to the house. The trees were an excellent source for fire wood so he neatly stacked it for us so that we could use it in our fireplace going forward. Marvin was prompt in responding to our concerns and request and with a very fair price! He and his team were on time as promised and cleaned up the areas when they were finished. We will definitely use Freeman’s Tree Care in the future and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: paul .creighton
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew did an absolutely amazing and fantastic job today by removing five big trees from around my log cabin. The trees weee between my cabin and my gravel road with power lines running perpendicular from the trees Marvin assured me that he and his crew could remove the trees and not damage neither the power lines nor my cabin and he did exactly that If I ever need any more trees removed from my property in the future I wouldn’t hesitate to use Freeman Tree Services and I definitely recommend them for anyone looking for a professional tree removal company They are the best you will find in Haywood County

reviews.author: Jill Rubin
reviews.text: I call this company every year to maintain my property including cut back branches overcrowding the driveway, touching the house, or a full removal of a dead tree. Marvin does a great job, shows up timely, fair price. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Jeff McAlear
reviews.text: We could not be more pleased with the service and quality of the job performed by Marvin Freeman and his crew. We had our view completely opened up and had another tree trimmed down that presented a fall hazard to our new home. The professionalism, work quality and friendly attitude by the team ensures we will call them back with any additional work needed. We highly recommend Freeman Tree Care and that you give them a call.

reviews.author: Jerry Long
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew have done several jobs for me at different locations over the last few months. He is prompt to show up for estimates and on time getting the work done. His crew is efficient, safe and conscientious in their clean up.

reviews.author: Scotty Mac Leod
reviews.text: Freeman Tree service checks all the boxes for great customer service…..phone calls returned promptly, competitive pricing, great explanation of work to be done , work scheduled completed as agreed , and work area left clean and picked up. Marvin and Jeremy did an excellent job removing trees and also creating a “window “ to open up my mountain view. They went out of their way and beyond to make sure the job was done to my satisfaction. Thank you both!

reviews.author: Michaeline Parrish
reviews.text: Marvin Freeman impressed me from the time he arrived and throughout the entire work experience. His understanding of what trees at my cabin were invasive, were overgrown and the ones that were actually dangerous to the safety of my home. His pricing was reasonable and fair. He arrived when he said he would, sent photos throughout the tree removal process and his communication was superior. He will be my first call for tree work in the future.

reviews.author: Misty Roberts
reviews.text: Marvin and his guys did an excellent job in cutting some trees in my yard especially two Bradford trees that had grown over the roof of my house. They were dangerous so it was important to cut them down. I also appreciate Marvin and his crew removing the stumps.

reviews.author: Andre Scharroo
reviews.text: They arrived exactly when they said they would and did an excellent job! One man climbed up high and topped around 6 trees that were beginning to block our view of the valley. Another man dropped a couple of smaller trees that were too small to climb. We highly reccomend Freeman Tree Care for their professionalism and good pricing. We will call them again whenever we need more tree work.

reviews.author: john mclaughlin
reviews.text: Marvin and his team are the best, communicative, professional and very responsive! True Tree Artists they gave us amazing long range views without just clear cutting all of our beautiful trees. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jonathan Rubin
reviews.text: Marvin did a great job on tree removal and trimming. He was easy to communicate with. He did a great job for a fair price. And he showed up when he said he would. We would highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Eric Rutherford
reviews.text: Marvin and the crew came over to remove three trees. Two of the trees were dead and threatened the house. The third (really big) tree would hit the driveway and definitely demolish the concrete. The crew arrived on time and ready to work. As Marvin was getting ready to climb the first tree, he brought my attention to another behind it (that you couldn't see) that was also dead. We added it to the list of trees to cut. The crew made quick work of all four trees and moved some previously cut wood for us. They also blew off the driveway even though they hadn't gotten anything on it. The whole project was reasonably priced and done in less time than I thought it would take. I definitely would recommend Freeman Tree Care.

reviews.author: r holmes
reviews.text: Unfortunately I must revise my former 5 star review to 1 star. I called Marvin on May 30 to ask him to trim a dogwood tree. He told me he had a small job the next day and would then come by my home. We waited until 5 pm, and never heard from him, not even a phone call. Now nearing the end of June he obviously is not interested in my job. Wish he had told me that nearly a month ago. We have found another service. So long Marvin! Marvin, I spoke to YOU on Sunday evening, May 26. You said you had a small job on Monday, May 27th and would come to my house when done with that job. If you can't remember an appointment for 24 hours why would me, a customer chase YOU down. You did work for the former owner of my home for years, Henrietta recommend you and you trimmed my Maple tree in Sept. Don't put your failure to keep appointments on me.

reviews.author: LGO
reviews.text: Freeman Tree Care did a great job at my place removing limbs that were blocking the satellite signal. Marvin was professional and courteous, and he showed up when he said he would! After he cleaned up the leaves from the trimming, he even blew the rest of the leaves off my whole yard as a bonus. Great service at a great price.

reviews.author: Lisa Womack
reviews.text: Marvin is great to work with and understands the kind of service you need. He has great knowledge about trees and their growth. He can professionally advise you about the health or damage that can happen. He has fair pricing and does work in a timely neat manner.

reviews.author: Craig Edwards
reviews.text: Marvin and the men are amazing! Best quote that we found and their work ethic is great. They have tree and bush removal down to a fine art. No time wasted. With these guys you can’t go wrong. We will definitely us them again.

reviews.author: John Stover
reviews.text: Giving a bad review is ALWAYS a last option for me, especially for a local business. However, I've been lied to, stood up and ultimately ghosted by Marvin (owner). After payment in full (over $3000) more than 5 weeks ago now, I was promised he would be back with mulch to finish the job. After a no show, 3 times in 1 week, he's just stopped returning communication all together. I realize its just mulch and I'm only 'out' a few hundred bucks, but there are PLENTY of other options in our community for this kind of service. Choose integrity and honesty and support someone else....NOT FREEMANS TREE CARE.

reviews.author: Avery Messer
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew did a really good job for some of the trees/branches I have hanging around my house, 10/10 recommend for future services and recommend to anyone else!!

reviews.author: Sabrina Sitton
reviews.text: Marvin did so well with our property. He toke down two massive oak trees with ease. He also fixed my driveway from all the rain this year. He used his time wisely which was nice since I was paying him by the hour. Highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Susan Trahan
reviews.text: Marvin and Frankie were a pleasure to work with. They removed four trees at a fair price, respected our property, and cleaned up well. Marvin is very responsive and shows up when he says he will.

reviews.author: T Grasty
reviews.text: Marvin did some work at our house and my moms house this week. We couldn’t be more pleased. This company is dependable and reasonably priced. We would definitely recommend them. I know we will be using their services again when we have work that needs to done.

reviews.author: Nick Owens
reviews.text: Freeman does amazing work quick response time..very professional from trimming and cutting to cleaning up and at a fair price. And didn't try to upsale me anything that I didnt need but instead made some recommendations.

reviews.author: tracy sanders
reviews.text: Marvin and his awesome crew did a great job. He was promptly on the job and had it all done in a timely manner. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Nani Metz
reviews.text: Marvin and his uncle removed 3 large trees , all the debris, in a very short time frame! He was kind and efficient. We will use their service again ! Thanks to the Freeman team !

reviews.author: Brenda East
reviews.text: Wonderful professional business. We had a tree fall on our house on a Sunday. Within 30 minutes they arrived and cleared everything off our home and placed a tarp. Returned to finish the clean up on Monday. Fair pricing, responsive and efficient. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Tom Murphy
reviews.text: Marvin and his team showed up when they said they would and the performed the work we agreed on at a price that matched the estimate They took down some trees for us and repaired creek damage from Helene! Thanks Marvin!

reviews.author: Emily Nichols
reviews.text: We had two large trees near our house needed to be removed, he was professional and efficient in taking down the trees, taking great respect of our property and cleaning up afterwards. We will be using Freeman Tree Care expert services again soon.

reviews.author: Sherri Williams
reviews.text: Marvin is an easy going, all around good guy to work with. His fees are reasonable and his work is superb. He has been a real asset to our 50 acre property.

reviews.author: Daniel Nally
reviews.text: Marvin and team did an incredible job removing two 80 foot locust trees that were uprooting and near falling. I was amazed by their skill and ability to bring the trees down gracefully, considering the tricky maneuvering that was required. Can’t say enough about the work they did.

reviews.author: John Giannini
reviews.text: I’ve used tree services before but Freeman’s crew was very professional polite and cleaned up afterwards better than expected, do not hesitate to use this company, fair price and no nonsense tree professionals that you can count on, all my thanks to this crew !

reviews.author: Gabe Eveland
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. I texted in the morning and they were there that afternoon to take a look and give an estimate. They arrived the following morning and had 4 giant trees down safely in 3 hours. Super professional and exactly as described.

reviews.author: Dan Thompson
reviews.text: Mr. Freeman and his small crew did an excellent job taking down a 24" tree 6 fteet from our house. Very reasonable and was able to take down the dying tree the day after he looked at it ( which was the day I calle d him) after raking up the small stuff he used a pack pack blower to do a final clean up.

reviews.author: alice herring
reviews.text: Gave reasonable quote within 1 day of calling, and then came by the end of the week. Cherry tree was cut down, hauled off and cleaned up by mid-afternoon. 3 hard working men arrived in morning and worked until job was done-very professional and friendly!!!

reviews.author: David Lassalle
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew did a great job. They were fast and efficient and did a great job. They also had the equipment to handle the task. I would highly recommend

reviews.author: Shannon Hayes
reviews.text: Marvin did a fantastic job trimming back some VERY overgrown shrubs and took care of a volunteer tree for me. He cleaned up all the debris afterwards. I highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: Tyler Beck
reviews.text: Fair prices for great work!! These dudes got it going on call Marvin up for all your tree needs you won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Eliot York
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew were really nice to work with. They installed our Starlink about 80 feet up in a pine tree and it’s working great.

reviews.author: Carl Metzger
reviews.text: Marvin and crew did an excellent job removing three difficult trees from our yard. We would highly recommend them for tree work.

reviews.author: Wendy Campbell
reviews.text: Great experience! They came out on time and did a great job removing an eyesore of a hanging tree limb and vines. Very nice. Very professional. Very fair price. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Barbara Boat
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Marvin was timely, professional, efficient, knows his trees, and delivered what he promised.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.text: Outstanding quality results and work ethic from Marvin. This is your go to place for tree work and Hardscapes!

reviews.author: Russell Allen
reviews.text: I can’t recommend these guys enough! They answer the phone, they show up quickly, they clean up like they weren’t even there, and they are very affordable!

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.text: Removed several trees safely and efficiently. Work started and was completed on the date they said it would.

reviews.author: Wyatt Beasley
reviews.text: Absolutely the guys for the job! Very fast and know exactly what they are doing! Couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Cherie Smith
reviews.text: Let’s start at the beginning. I received a text that Freeman Tree Care was in the area and were giving free quotes. So I set-up an appointment with Marvin. He came out and gave us a quote to do tree trimming and removal of a couple of downed trees. His price was very reasonable so we hired him. A few days later he was at our house with Justin, Francisco, and Pablo. Justin joined me on my back porch since we live in a log cabin with a treehouse view of the Blue Ridge parkway mountains. Justin gave Francisco and Pablo instructions. Francisco and Pablo were amazing. They were always tied off and worked safely. They really opened up our Mountain View and I love it. They did not leave the trees until I was happy with results. Then they removed all branches and used their wood chipper to clean everything up. They also moved the downed trees. Marvin is working up a quote to do some stone work and landscaping for me. I cant wait to see what he comes up with! All I can say is these guys are amazing! Save yourself some time and give Marvin a call! You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Renee Schwenn
reviews.text: Marvin and his crew were efficient and kept it tidy. Marvin gave good knowledge and insight on how to manage my ideas and wants for the property. I highly recommend for your outdoor project and tree removal/maintenance

reviews.author: Marty Warren
reviews.text: Marvin and his team did an excellent job on the trees I needed removed and the large oak that was trimmed up. They were very professional and I would use the again for any tree work I need. Thanks again to the entire team.

reviews.author: Sally Curley
reviews.text: We can't say enough about the excellent communication, responsiveness, and work that Marvin Freeman and his crew have completed for us twice. In fact, we hired him immediately for a third project. They are professional, care about you and your property and, often most importantly, cleanup is outstanding. H went above and beyond by moving 5 ENORMOUS stones to the edge of our driveway to act as a border where trees had been - without being asked -- so that the landscaping looked professional. It looks incredible and we are so thankful. THANK YOU Marvin and your team for all your amazing work!!!!!
